unit.title: Area and Perimeter
unit.blurb: Finding area by counting whole and half squares, measuring perimeter, and calculating the area and perimeter of rectangles.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Estimate and measure the area and perimeter of 2D shapes on squared paper.

O2.t: Calculate the area and perimeter of rectangles.

sections.title: Estimating and measuring area and perimeter

p: **Area** is the space inside a shape, measured in **square centimetres (cm²)**. Count the whole squares inside.
**Perimeter** is the distance around the edge. On squared paper, count the edges of the squares all the way round.
Area counts squares inside; perimeter counts the edges around.

Before you read on: is the perimeter the space inside a shape?

options.fb: They are different measurements.
The space inside is the area.

options.t: No – it is the distance around the edge

p: **Area of a rectangle = length × width**. A 7 cm by 4 cm rectangle has area 28 cm².
**Perimeter = length + width + length + width**, or 2 × (length + width) = 22 cm.
Area is in cm², perimeter in cm.
